salarycert.subject: TO WHOM IT MAY CONCERN
salarycert.body1: This is to certify that {name}{fatherClause} bearing National ID No. {nid} and Employee ID {empNo}, has been employed with {company} as {designation}{deptClause} since {date} and continues to serve in that capacity as of the date of issue of this certificate.
salarycert.body2: {name} draws a monthly gross salary of {gross} ({words}), comprising a basic salary of {basic} plus allowances.
salarycert.body3: This certificate is issued at the request of the employee for whatever purpose it may serve.

loanagreement.title: STAFF LOAN AGREEMENT
loanagreement.intro: This agreement is made between {company} ("the Company") and {name}, Employee ID {empNo}, holding the position of {designation} ("the Employee"), for a staff loan on the following terms:
loanagreement.term1: The Company shall disburse {principal} to the Employee as an interest-free staff loan.
loanagreement.term2: The Employee agrees to repay the loan through monthly deductions of {installment} from salary, commencing the payroll cycle immediately following disbursement, until the full principal is recovered.
loanagreement.term3: Should the Employee's service with the Company terminate for any reason before the loan is fully repaid, the outstanding balance shall become immediately due and shall be recovered from any final settlement (salary, gratuity, or other dues) payable to the Employee.
loanagreement.term4: This loan is granted at the sole discretion of the Company as a staff welfare measure and does not constitute a precedent or entitlement for future loans.
loanagreement.term5: Both parties acknowledge and agree to the terms set out above by their signatures below.

resolution.closing: There being no other business, the meeting concluded with a vote of thanks to the Chair.
